# `intent agents`

**Generated by `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/gen_reference.sh` at 2026-11-25 18:55Z. Do not edit -- re-run it.**

Manage AGENTS.md -- the primary tool-agnostic LLM config at project root

|                                      |                                                     |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Revision this describes              | `973564a3cb03153fcd84b84a3de4baa82e2ecead` (`HEAD`) |
| Release presence is reported against | `v3.5.3`                                            |

**The register is a declaration, not a behaviour claim.** The command surface is built from `surface/dispatch-table.json`, so the register at a revision states what that revision exposes. It does not state that any of it works. Where this page and your binary disagree, **your binary is right**.

**No exit codes are listed per command.** Every command follows the one surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes).

## The commands

| Command                  | What it does                                                                                   | In v3.5.3 | Reads or writes | Undo       |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ---------- |
| `intent agents`          | Manage AGENTS.md for Intent projects                                                           | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent agents init`     | Initialize AGENTS.md at project root                                                           | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent agents generate` | Emit generated AGENTS.md content to stdout                                                     | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent agents sync`     | Regenerate AGENTS.md from current project state                                                | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent agents validate` | Validate AGENTS.md shape and required sections                                                 | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent agents layout`   | Move the two agent contracts to the root or into .claude/, and set the project's contracts key | yes       | mutate          | reversible |

## `intent agents`

Manage AGENTS.md for Intent projects

```
intent agents [<command>]
```

|                 |                                                            |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| In `v3.5.3`     | yes                                                        |
| Reads or writes | read                                                       |
| Undo            | not applicable -- the register records this verb as a read |
| Over MCP        | no                                                         |

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Type         | Required | Values | Notes |
| --------- | ------------ | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| `command` | `subcommand` | no       |        |       |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent agents --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent agents layout`

Move the two agent contracts to the root or into .claude/, and set the project's contracts key

```
intent agents layout <layout>
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.5.3`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | reversible |
| Over MCP        | no         |

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type     | Required | Values              | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `layout` | `string` | yes      | `root`, `dotclaude` | `root` keeps AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at the project root, where the agents.md spec's readers open them; `dotclaude` keeps both in .claude/, for a tree whose root people read rather than tools. |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent agents layout --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## Refusals

**There is no per-command refusal list, because the register does not carry one.** A row declares its path, arguments, flags, target, disposition, recoverability, MCP exposure and read-or-mutate, and nothing structural about what it refuses.

The estate-wide roster of refusal variants is in [what Intent ships at this revision](cut-surface.md), taken from a roster that declares itself exhaustive and is checked as one. **It is not attributed to commands anywhere**, and attributing it by reading the variant names would be a guess dressed as a reference.
